compiled_state.title: RED: Implement orphan-band plan subcommand writing dry-run manifest
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: An orphan-band dry-run manifest enumerates every orphan anomaly with class label, side (local-only or jira-only), and proposed remediation, written to bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-<pass>.manifest.json

## Given / When / Then
Given a seeded ticket store with 3 orphan anomalies (2 local-only, 1 jira-only) and a clean bridge_state/bootstrap/ directory; When python -m dso_reconciler.orphan_band plan --pass 2026-05-22-01 is invoked; Then exit code is 0 AND bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-2026-05-22-01.manifest.json exists with pass_id, anomalies array of length 3 each carrying class_label/side/proposed_remediation, AND no Jira/local-tracker mutations occurred.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] plan subcommand writes manifest to bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-<pass>.manifest.json with required shape
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_plan.py::test_plan_writes_manifest
- [ ] plan subcommand performs no Jira or local-tracker mutations
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_plan.py::test_plan_is_dry_run
- [ ] Every manifest anomaly entry carries class_label, side in {local-only, jira-only}, proposed_remediation
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_plan.py::test_manifest_schema

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/__init__.py (Create)
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/orphan_band.py (Create)
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_plan.py (Create)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
